title: イングリッシュマスター  (An English Master)

segments.t: One wrong word nearly got Muranishi thrown out of Nakai's mansion, so he thinks fast. He promises Nakai that practicing a handful of cheerful English words will make him an instant hit abroad—and soon both men are shouting at the top of their lungs. Listen to Muranishi close his very first sale.
めっそうもございません！お薦めする理由がもう一つあります。
何だ？
愛のコミュニケーションを取ることができます。
ここに書かれている言葉を覚えて使えば大丈夫です。
例えば？
シンプルに、オー、グッド、グッド！
それだったら俺も言えるぜ。グッド！
パーフェクトでございます！
ハロー！ラブ！グッド！
あんたたち！
奥様、明日からご主人はイングリッシュマスターになります。
買ってもいい？
From panicked humility to triumphant applause, Muranishi rides every emotional wave in Japanese. Let's look at the key expressions.
めっそうもございません！
"'Perish the thought!' Built around humble " Listen for
めっそう
, this old-fashioned set expression waves away an accusation—'heaven forbid, I would never dream of looking down on you!'
お薦めする理由がもう一つあります。
'There is one more reason I recommend this.'  We can hear
お薦め
this word means recommendation—the word printed on every restaurant menu's chef specials!
もう一つ
adds 'one more'.
ここに書かれている言葉を覚えて使えば大丈夫です。
'If you learn and use the words written here, you are all set.'  Listen for
ここに書かれている
describes words 'written here'. Linking
覚えて
, memorize, to
使えば
, if you use, leads smoothly into reassuring
大丈夫です
例えば？
"'For example?' One word, " We can hear
例えば？
, works both to introduce your own example and, with a rising voice, to ask someone 'such as?'
それだったら俺も言えるぜ。
'If that is all, I can say it too.'  It features
それだったら
this word means 'if it is just that'. Turning the verb for 'to say' into
言える
builds 'can say', and masculine
ぜ
adds swagger.
パーフェクトでございます！
"'That is absolute perfection!' Muranishi dresses up English 'perfect'—" Starting off with
パーフェクト
—with grand
でございます
, cheering his customer like a prize pupil.
あんたたち！
"'Hey, you two!' Hearing the commotion, Nakai's wife bursts in shouting " We can hear
あんたたち！
, and this word is built from casual
あんた
, you, plus group-marker
たち
奥様、明日からご主人はイングリッシュマスターになります。
"'Madam, starting tomorrow your husband becomes an English master.' Notice the respectful pair for someone else's marriage: " Focus on
奥様
addresses a wife politely, while
ご主人
refers to her husband.
買ってもいい？
"'Can I buy it?' After acting like a tough boss all afternoon, Nakai meekly asks his wife " You can catch
買ってもいい
, literally 'is buying okay?'—the everyday pattern with
もいい
for asking permission! Now let's listen to Muranishi's first victorious sale from start to finish.

例えば？

それだったら俺も言えるぜ。グッド！
パーフェクトでございます！

Take away these expressions: the word for recommendations, the one for 'for example', and the phrase whenever you want to ask if it is okay to buy something. See you in scene fifteen.
ありがとうございます、また会いましょう。
